title: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2019-7481 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03 · used by ransomware
body: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Android OS Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2011-1823 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-09-08
body: The vold volume manager daemon in Android kernel trusts messages from a PF_NETLINK socket, which allows an attacker to execute code and gain root privileges. This vulnerability is associated with GingerBreak and Exploit.AndroidOS.Lotoor. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Exim Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) Improper Input Validation
sub: CVE-2019-10149 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-01-10
body: Improper validation of recipient address in deliver_message() function in /src/deliver.c may lead to remote command execution. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: External Proxy
sub: T1090.002 · command and control
body: Adversaries may use an external proxy to act as an intermediary for network communications to a command and control server to avoid direct connections to their infrastructure. Many tools exist that enable traffic redirection through proxies or port redirection, including HTRAN, ZXProxy, and ZXPortMap. Adversaries use these types of proxies to manage command and control communications, to provide resiliency in the face of connection loss, or to ride over existing trusted communications paths to avoid suspicion. External connection proxies are used to mask the destination of C2 traffic and are typically implemented with port redirectors. Compromised systems outside of the victim environment…

title: Apache HTTP Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
sub: CVE-2021-40438 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-12-01 · used by ransomware
body: A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: SKYSEA Client View Improper Authentication Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2016-7836 · exploited in the wild, listed 2025-10-14
body: SKYSEA Client View contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows remote code execution via a flaw in processing authentication on the TCP connection with the management console program. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Password Spraying
sub: T1110.003 · credential access
body: Adversaries may use a single or small list of commonly used passwords against many different accounts to attempt to acquire valid account credentials. Password spraying uses one password (e.g. 'Password01'), or a small list of commonly used passwords, that may match the complexity policy of the domain. Logins are attempted with that password against many different accounts on a network to avoid account lockouts that would normally occur when brute forcing a single account with many passwords. Typically, management services over commonly used ports are used when password spraying. Commonly targeted services include the following: * SSH (22/TCP) * Telnet (23/TCP) * FTP (21/TCP) * NetBIOS / SMB…

title: Kaseya VSA Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2018-20753 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-04-13 · used by ransomware
body: Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2026-49869 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-09-02
body: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials. What to do: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

title: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2023-42917 · exploited in the wild, listed 2023-12-04
body: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing. What to do: Apply remediations or mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if remediation or mitigations are unavailable.

title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2024-27443 · exploited in the wild, listed 2025-05-19
body: Zimbra Collaboration contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the CalendarInvite feature of the Zimbra webmail classic user interface. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability via an email message containing a crafted calendar header, leading to the execution of arbitrary JavaScript code. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Android Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2020-0041 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03
body: Android Kernel binder_transaction of binder.c contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability due to an incorrect bounds check that could allow for local privilege escalation. This vulnerability was observed chained with CVE-2019-2215 and CVE-2020-0069 under exploit chain "AbstractEmu." What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Selective Exclusion
sub: T1679 · stealth
body: Adversaries may intentionally exclude certain files, folders, directories, file types, or system components from encryption or tampering during a ransomware or malicious payload execution. Some file extensions that adversaries may avoid encrypting include `.dll`, `.exe`, and `.lnk`. Adversaries may perform this behavior to avoid alerting users, to evade detection by security tools and analysts, or, in the case of ransomware, to ensure that the system remains operational enough to deliver the ransom notice. Exclusions may target files and components whose corruption would cause instability, break core services, or immediately expose the attack. By carefully avoiding these areas, adversaries…

title: Shoulder Surfing
sub: CAPEC-508 · likelihood: high
body: In a shoulder surfing attack, an adversary observes an unaware individual's keystrokes, screen content, or conversations with the goal of obtaining sensitive information. One motive for this attack is to obtain sensitive information about the target for financial, personal, political, or other gains. From an insider threat perspective, an additional motive could be to obtain system/application credentials or cryptographic keys. Shoulder surfing attacks are accomplished by observing the content "over the victim's shoulder", as implied by the name of this attack.

title: OS Credential Dumping
sub: T1003 · credential access
body: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material, normally in the form of a hash or a clear text password. Credentials can be obtained from OS caches, memory, or structures. Credentials can then be used to perform Lateral Movement and access restricted information. Several of the tools mentioned in associated sub-techniques may be used by both adversaries and professional security testers. Additional custom tools likely exist as well.

title: Weaken Encryption
sub: T1600 · defense impairment
body: Adversaries may compromise a network device’s encryption capability in order to bypass encryption that would otherwise protect data communications. Encryption can be used to protect transmitted network traffic to maintain its confidentiality (protect against unauthorized disclosure) and integrity (protect against unauthorized changes). Encryption ciphers are used to convert a plaintext message to ciphertext and can be computationally intensive to decipher without the associated decryption key. title: ASUS Live Update Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
